items.title: @dair_ai
items.summary: Judge reliability is under fresh scrutiny: summarized a large LLM-as-a-Judge audit across 21 judges, nine providers, and about 541K judgments. The key result is methodological: exact-match agreement materially overstates judge quality, while switching to Cohen’s kappa deflates agreement by 33–41 points on MT-Bench, with judge rankings shifting significantly. That’s a strong warning for teams using judge models as internal eval infrastructure.
